presentation.description: I specialize in building fast, accessible and visually polished web experiences. I primarily work with React, Vite and modern REST APIs, though I'm constantly adapting to whatever stack each challenge calls for.

experienceBands.description: Ground-up development of an Airbnb/Booking-style reservation platform for a mountain tourist destination in Argentina, alongside the backend developer. We started from a purely visual mockup (no real logic or functionality), which ended up almost entirely rewritten as the app's real behavior got defined. Beyond UI work, I actively contributed to shaping the business logic behind each type of booking.
achievements: Designed the booking logic for 4 completely distinct business types (accommodation, restaurant, experience, event), each with its own admin panel tailored to that industry's real-world rules

Implemented Restaurant's table-based reservation flow: table categories with capacity/count, shift scheduling by day and service type, and live availability calculation based on which reservations overlap in a given time slot
Worked on Accommodation's night-based availability model (date ranges, not time-based), including per-period rates, an occupied-dates calendar, and guest breakdown (adults/children)
Defined, together with the team, which actions each user type can see and perform (platform admin, business provider, tourist), reflecting that distinction in both the UI and the API calls

Built a reusable admin-panel design language (consistent editing, confirmation, and expand/collapse patterns) so managing any of the 4 business types feels consistent and simple, without duplicating logic across screens
Unified the booking flow end to end (states, typography, iconography) and added micro-interactions (height/opacity transitions) so state changes feel fluid

experience2.description: Development of an e-commerce platform with an internal management system and technical service quoting. Contributed primarily as Backend Developer, designing the REST API and relational database architecture.
achievements: Designed and implemented a REST API using Node.js, Express and MySQL with Sequelize ORM, structuring models, relationships and validations for products, services, quotes and orders
Built a file upload and management system with Multer, including type and size validations, storing payment proofs and documents directly on the server
Integrated a notification system with transactional email delivery via Resend, covering quote and order lifecycle events for both clients and administrators

experience1.description: Development of an automated booking and payment system via WhatsApp for the barbershop 'El Bigote Siberiano', storing data in Google services such as Sheets and Calendar. Project paused during the Mercado Pago API integration phase at the client's request.
achievements: Designed and developed an end-to-end booking ecosystem integrating the WhatsApp Business API, Make and Google Workspace, automating the scheduling flow and reducing the administrative workload of the business
Built a natural language processing engine in TypeScript to normalize dates and times to ISO 8601 format
Improved booking success rate by migrating from an unstable generative AI model to a deterministic logic flow system, eliminating interpretation errors and ensuring accurate data capture

about1.title: Who I am
about1.description: Originally from La Rioja, Argentina — a technology enthusiast since childhood, venturing into computing and later into programming, where I found my passion building systems and solving problems along the way while working as a developer. I'm also eager to get into game development, studying this new field on my own, so that one day I can dedicate myself to it full-time.

about2.title: My experience
about2.description: Full-Stack Developer, later working freelance and currently at BandS. My experience ranges from ERP systems to booking platforms and automation chatbots for businesses — using different technologies and adapting to each context to deliver the right solution for the client.
